name: owner_jj_cont_15m_big

source.title: JJ Simon's opening continuation on the first 15-minute bar, ONLY when the bar is over 25 points (his 50 / 76 line as the rule) -- the reviewers' idea, 2026-10-20

entry.words: At 09:45 ET read the 09:30 open and the 09:44 close. Only when they differ by more than 25 points: green buy, red sell, market at 09:45, 50-point stop, 76-point target (JJ: 'if the opening candle is larger than 25 points, 50 and 76 with half the contracts'). Once a day, nothing else.

taught: [KN7j6NXXAio 5:36] a candle over 25 points: 76 target, 50 stop, half the contracts
[KN7j6NXXAio 5:06] the continuation is the opening candle's colour
[owner_jj_cont_15m, 2026-10-19] the edge of the 15-minute continuation sat in its big-body trades: 568 of 940, 44.9% at 1:1.52, +$123 a trade; the small ones lost
not_run: SELECTION: the 25-point split is JJ's own number, but running it alone comes AFTER the 15-minute reading of owner_jj_cont_15m showed it (look 1 of this sheet; ~160 looks of the jj_fair family before it). The walk-forward judges the exit cell only; the blind months (2025-07 on) are the one out-of-sample read.
The bar size (15 minutes) is the owner's reading of JJ's 1-minute candle. The half size is sizing, not in this 1-contract ledger.
No bias / gap / wick filters (JJ names them; not run).
COSTS AND FILLS: the engine's own.
